/resources/chinese-science-fiction-magaz: Resources Chinese Science Fiction Submission Guide This page was researched and compiled by AI. Five adult Chinese-language science fiction magazines, bookazines, and publishing platforms are roughly ordered by an AI assessment of recognition and influence; the order is not a literary judgment. Requirements change, so check the linked guidelines before submitting. Last verified September 13, 2026. 01 Monthly Science Fiction World First choice Website Official website Guidelines Official submission guide · Contacts Email [email removed] ; book manuscripts over 30,000 Chinese characters: tushu@sfw.com.cn . Format Email attachment with a synopsis, biography, and contact details. Work requirements Original, unpublished Chinese SF with vivid characters, a complete plot, sound scientific logic, and a fresh idea. Payment RMB 150–300 per 1,000 Chinese characters, varying by quality and rights granted. 02 Bookazine Galaxy’s Edge (Chinese edition) Website 8 Light Minutes official Weibo Guidelines Official email notice · Full rules Email tougao@8light-minutes.com . Format Attach the manuscript; subject “Title + author.” Add legal name, phone, and contact details in the email. Work requirements Original, never published, and not simultaneously submitted. Any length; stories under 12,000 characters may receive translation priority. Payment RMB 150–200 per 1,000 Chinese characters. 03 Bimonthly Science Fiction Cube Website Publisher’s magazine page Guidelines Magazine profile · Official Weibo Email flowersbooks@126.com . Format No public template; a Word attachment with biography and contact details is recommended. Work requirements Original SF with strong literary expression; frontier-topic and creative-writing pieces are also considered. Unused submissions may be taken elsewhere after three months. Payment No fixed rate appears in the current public guidelines; confirm in the acceptance notice or contract. 04 Publishing platform Nonexistent Science Fiction Website Future Affairs Administration Guidelines Standing submission guide Email tougao@faa2001.com . Format Word attachment, 12-point SimSun; filename “Author-《Title》-character count.” Add a synopsis above 25,000 characters. Work requirements Original SF of any style and length. Works under 50,000 characters must be complete; novels need at least 50,000 finished characters. No prior publication or simultaneous submissions. Payment RMB 200–300/1,000 characters up to 25,000; RMB 100/1,000 above that for digital publication, with print payment separate. 05 International platform Eastern Wood Website Official website Guidelines Open submissions · Standing guidelines Email submissions@easternwood.co . Format .docx only; email subject and filename “Author-《Title》-exact character count.” State the rights status in the email. Work requirements General submissions run 5,000–35,000 characters. Preference for unpublished, Chinese-rooted stories featuring Chinese people or communities, regional culture, and frontier technology. Payment RMB 300–500 per 1,000 Chinese characters plus derivative-rights revenue sharing. Its separate 2026 novel contest has a RMB 150,000+ prize pool.

/resources/science-fiction-awards.html: Resources 2026 Science Fiction Awards Six awards ordered by their 2026 ceremony dates. “Deadline” distinguishes direct submissions from nomination or reader-voting cutoffs. Information last checked September 19, 2026; dates not yet announced are marked clearly. May 30 2026 · Berkeley Locus Awards [WORLD-LEVEL] English translation? Usually yes for a Chinese-language original. The 2026 awards introduced Best Translated Novel, aimed at translated novels published in English during 2025. Eligible works Science fiction, fantasy, and horror published in 2025 across the poll’s categories. Voters may write in works not included on the Locus Recommended Reading List. Selection No traditional jury. The results are determined by the Locus reader poll; voting is free and open to all, with subscriber votes traditionally weighted more heavily. Deadline April 1, 2026 — reader ballot, not a direct author-submission deadline. Official poll 2026 results June 6 2026 · Chicago Nebula Awards [WORLD-LEVEL] English translation? Yes for a Chinese-language work: it must first be published in English in the United States during 2025 to meet the published-work rule. Eligible works Science fiction, fantasy, or related-genre work first published in English in the United States from January 1 through December 31, 2025. Fiction categories are divided by word count; comics and poetry were added for this award year. Selection Eligible SFWA Full, Associate, and Senior members nominate and vote. A Nebula Awards Commissioner and the SFWA Awards Rules Committee administer eligibility; there is no separate literary jury. Deadline February 28, 2026 — member nomination deadline. Authors cannot nominate their own work, but non-members may send an eligible electronic copy to the Awards Commissioner for member consideration. How to participate Official rules 2026 ceremony August 15 2026 · Lenghu Lenghu Science Fiction Literature Award English translation? No. The competition accepts original Chinese-language science fiction. Eligible works Open to science-fiction writers and fans nationwide. Entries had to include at least one of these elements: Mars, aerospace, or the Lenghu Astronomical Base. Short fiction: 5,000–20,000 Chinese characters; mid-length fiction: 30,000–50,000. Selection Anonymous judging through preliminary, secondary, and final rounds. The 2026 judging team included co-founder Yang Feng and science-fiction writer Bao Shu. Deadline April 1, 2026 — direct submission deadline by email. 2026 call for entries 2026 ceremony report August 30 2026 · Anaheim Hugo Awards [WORLD-LEVEL] English translation? Not formally required. A work first published anywhere in 2025 may be eligible; a work first published in English translation in 2025 can also receive 2026 eligibility. In practice, an English edition greatly improves access for voters. Eligible works Science-fiction and fantasy works or achievements from 2025 in the relevant categories. Authors do not submit directly and do not need to be Worldcon members to be nominated. Selection Eligible WSFS members nominate and LAcon V members vote on the final ballot. Hugo Administrators appointed by the year’s Worldcon administer eligibility and counting; there is no judging panel. Deadline March 28, 2026 at noon PDT — nomination ballot. Final voting closed August 8, 2026 at noon PDT. Official 2026 Hugo page 2026 nomination rules Hugo FAQ September 11 2026 · Zigong Galaxy Award English translation? No. The fiction and original-book categories concern Chinese-language science fiction. Eligible works The fiction-award route principally covers work published in the Galaxy Award section of Science Fiction World or books led by the magazine; accepted magazine work automatically gains eligibility. Best Original Book was open to all original Simplified Chinese science-fiction books formally published in China during 2025. Selection Reader-voted preliminary selection, professional review, and a final jury. The 37th award’s final jury was chaired by Liu Cixin. Deadline No separate, unified author-submission deadline was published. Publication during 2025 was the eligibility boundary; the 2026 preliminary reader ballot closed February 28. New fiction can be submitted to Science Fiction World on a rolling basis. Official award page Magazine submissions Official short-fiction results Official short-mid-length results November 13–15 2026 · Chengdu Chinese Nebula Awards English translation? No. Work categories must be expressed and published in Chinese; the awards also include a category for Chinese translations of non-Chinese work. Eligible works Chinese-language science fiction published from January 1 through December 31, 2025. The 17th awards cover novels, mid-length fiction, short fiction, translated works, nonfiction, criticism, new writers, and the “Star Bridge” category. Authors or authorized rights holders may submit. Selection An invited recommendation committee of at least 50 members conducts preliminary and second-round voting; a final jury selects the Gold and Silver awards. The organizing committee is chaired by science-fiction writer He Xi. Deadline December 31, 2025 — direct online submission deadline. Final judging ran April 1–30, 2026. The ceremony will be held at the Chengdu Science Fiction Museum during Chengdu Science Fiction Week, November 13–15. 2026 charter Submission guide 2026 shortlist notice Chengdu Science Fiction Week announcement 37th Galaxy Award: Major Literary Results Best Novel No award Best Novella 《山之灵》杨晚晴；《英雄专属剧场》汪彦中；《母探四郎》灰狐 Best Short-Mid-Length Fiction 《青空》张冉；《动画家与上釉师》菊储；《被嫌弃的废卡的一生》天平；《虚影人生》阿缺；《泰坦坠落于众神之影》华焉辛 Best Short Story 《朝生暮死》华焉辛；《火星绮梦》廖舒波；“太空疯人院”·《玩具恐怖主义》潘海天 Best Original Book 《刹海》陈楸帆；《脑洞问答机：关于人类未来的 20 种想象》王诺诺 Best New Writer 华焉辛；如星也 Web-fiction awards 最佳科幻网络文学：《赛博英雄传》吾道长不孤；最佳网络科幻作家：远瞳；最佳网络科幻海外传播：《末日乐园》须尾俱全

/zh/resources/chinese-science-fiction-ma: 资源 中文科幻小说投稿指南 本页由 AI 搜集和整理。以下五个面向成人作者的中文科幻刊物、杂志书与出版平台，按 AI 对行业知名度与影响力的综合判断大致排列；排序不代表文学评价。投稿规则会调整，发送前请再次打开征稿链接核对。资料核对至 2026 年 9 月 13 日。 01 月刊 《科幻世界》 首选 官网 科幻世界官方网站 征稿链接 官方征稿启事 · 官方联系方式 投递邮箱 [email removed] ；3 万字以上图书稿投 tushu@sfw.com.cn 。 投递格式 电子邮件附件；稿首附故事梗概、作者简介与姓名、QQ、电话、地址等联系方式。官网没有规定统一的字体或文件名模板。 作品要求 未在期刊、图书或网络公开发表的原创科幻小说。重视鲜明人物、完整情节、科学逻辑与具有新意的科幻点子。 稿费 150—300 元/千字，根据稿件授权情况与质量浮动。 02 MOOK 《银河边缘》中文版 官网 八光分文化官方微博 征稿链接 官方邮箱变更公告 · 完整投稿规则 投递邮箱 tougao@8light-minutes.com （唯一收稿邮箱）。 投递格式 小说作为附件发送，合理分段；邮件主题写“作品名称＋作者名”，邮件末尾附真名、手机等联系方式。 作品要求 本人原创、从未在任何平台发表，且不可一稿多投。字数不限；1.2 万字以内的短篇佳作有优先翻译发表机会。 稿费 150—200 元/千字，优稿优酬。 03 双月刊 《科幻立方》 官网 百花文艺出版社期刊页 征稿链接 期刊介绍与投稿说明 · 官方微博 投递邮箱 flowersbooks@126.com 。 投递格式 公开说明仅指定邮箱，未公布统一模板；建议使用 Word 附件，并在正文留下作者简介与联系方式。 作品要求 以原创科幻小说为主体，注重文学性表达；也接受科幻前沿专题及创意写作稿件。三个月未刊用可自行处理。 稿费 现行公开征稿说明未列明固定标准，以编辑部录用通知或合同为准。 04 出版平台 不存在科幻 官网 未来事务管理局 征稿链接 长期征稿说明 投递邮箱 tougao@faa2001.com 。 投递格式 Word 附件，宋体 12 号；文件名“作者名-《文章名》-字数”。2.5 万字以上须附情节大纲或故事梗概。 作品要求 各种风格的原创科幻，字数不限；5 万字以内须交完整稿，长篇至少完成前 5 万字。稿件不得已公开发表、授权或一稿多投。 稿费 2.5 万字以内 200—300 元/千字；2.5 万字以上电子发表 100 元/千字，实体出版稿费另付。 05 国际科幻平台 异事悟 Eastern Wood 官网 异事悟官方网站 征稿链接 官网征稿中心 · 长期征稿细则 投递邮箱 submissions@easternwood.co （注意后缀是 .co）。 投递格式 仅收 .docx 附件；邮件与文件名均为“作者名-《文章名》-精确字数”，邮件正文注明版权情况。 作品要求 常规稿约 5,000—35,000 字，优先未发表作品；关注以中国人或华人为主要角色、植根中国文化地域与前沿科技的科幻叙事。 稿费 300—500 元/千字，另有衍生分成。2026 年“近未来”长篇征文另设总奖金池 15 万元以上、金奖 5 万元。
